name: nest-microservices
description: NestJS microservices: API Gateway, Users, Orders, Notifications (Prisma, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ)

scripts.build: nest build api-gateway && nest build users && nest build orders && nest build notifications
scripts.dev: concurrently -n users,orders,notifications,gateway -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "nest start users --watch" "nest start orders --watch" "nest start notifications --watch" "nest start api-gateway --watch"
scripts.prisma:generate: prisma generate --config prisma/users.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma/orders.config.ts && prisma generate --config prisma/notifications.config.ts
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: prisma migrate deploy --config prisma/users.config.ts && prisma migrate deploy --config prisma/orders.config.ts && prisma migrate deploy --config prisma/notifications.config.ts
scripts.setup: npm run infra:up && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy && npm run rabbit:setup
